texts.zh: 我方军团已成功进入[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
texts.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it may take some time for the natives to become fully productive members of [Root.GetAdj] society.

texts.zh: 我们的军团成功地入侵并战胜了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]部队。当地种族明智地决定臣服于我们，而我们则开始按政策对其进行净化，以为[Root.GetAdj]的产业腾出地块。
texts.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the [GetPreFTLLower] forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have wisely elected to succumb to our rule, and we have now begun to purge them from the planet as per policy, in order to prime the terrain for [Root.GetAdj] industry.

texts.zh: 我们的秩序维持者们成功地镇压了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族。当[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]意识到我们只想为它们服务时，它们无奈停止了其古怪的抵抗。目前它们正在被送往特别设计的居住站，我们将确保它们丰衣足食。不幸的是，它们发育不全的头脑可能需要花一点时间，才能适应摆脱自我决定之苦的生活。
texts.en: Our peacekeeping enforcers have successfully pacified the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were coerced into ceasing their quaint attempts at resistance when they realized we only desire to serve them. They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.

texts.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体已被我们的登陆军团制服。尽管其低下的战斗力是不发达社会的表现，我们的生物分析机器人仍然认为其神经系统能力仍具有潜力。它们将被同化。
texts.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subjugated by our landing forces. Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.

texts.zh: 我们的猎杀者单元毫不费力便撕碎了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的有机土著建立起来的那点可怜的防线。任何幸存的样本都将被进行了系统性灭除，以确保它们不会进化出对星系造成有机污染的物种。
texts.en: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.

texts.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何残余的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]都将根据所制定的有机种族管理协议进行根除。
texts.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any remaining [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] will be removed in accordance with established bio-species management protocols.

texts.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何幸存的样本都将被并入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]能源网。
texts.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any surviving specimens will be amalgamated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] energy grid.

texts.zh: 原始的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]那种支离破碎的思想无法在[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]抗衡我们团结一致的陆军，整个地表都已完全占领。剩下的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们毫无用处，会根据[GetGestaltEntityName]的意志从这颗星球上抹除。
texts.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the surface has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are of no use to us, and will be expunged from the planet, as the [GetGestaltEntityName] wills.

texts.zh: [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]原始而一盘散沙的思维在[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]敌不过我们团结的登陆军团，行星表面已经被我们控制。剩余的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族将被用作家畜供养我们的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。
texts.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the planet has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] will be used as livestock to feed our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

label.zh: 异星人不是我们的对手！
label.en: The xenos are no match for us!

label.zh: 在他们看来，我们的武器一定就像是魔法……
label.en: To them our weapons must appear like magic...

label.zh: 我们神圣的政体闪耀出真理。
他们在我们的统治下能更好地进化。
label.en: Their evolution will benefit from our control.

label.zh: 我们的帝国壮大了。
我们的帝国壮大了。
它们将成为美妙的活体陈设！
开始身份升华。
开始武器测试……
收到。
